mapper.select: SELECT W.WORK_ITEM_SN,W.CO_ID,W.USER_ID,#{workYmd} WORK_YMD,W.WORK_YMD TASK_BGNG_YMD,W.EXPT_END_YMD,W.DONE_YMD,W.PRIORITY_NO,W.BIZ_ID,W.PARENT_WORK_ITEM_SN,W.SORT_SEQ,W.WORK_SE_CD,W.WORK_CN,COALESCE(P.PRGRS_STTS_CD,W.PRGRS_STTS_CD) PRGRS_STTS_CD,COALESCE(P.PRGRS_RT,W.PRGRS_RT) PRGRS_RT,COALESCE(P.ISSUE_CN,W.ISSUE_CN) ISSUE_CN,COALESCE(P.NEXT_PLAN_CN,W.NEXT_PLAN_CN) NEXT_PLAN_CN,B.BIZ_NM,B.BIZ_ABRV_NM,U.USER_NM FROM daily_work_item W LEFT JOIN daily_work_progress P ON P.WORK_ITEM_SN=W.WORK_ITEM_SN AND P.PRGRS_YMD=#{workYmd} AND P.USE_YN='Y' LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=W.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=W.USER_ID WHERE W.CO_ID=#{coId} AND W.USER_ID=#{userId} AND W.USE_YN='Y' AND W.WORK_YMD <= #{workYmd} AND (W.DONE_YMD IS NULL OR W.DONE_YMD >= #{workYmd}) ORDER BY IFNULL(W.PRIORITY_NO,3),W.SORT_SEQ,W.WORK_ITEM_SN

SELECT W.WORK_ITEM_SN,W.CO_ID,W.USER_ID,P.PRGRS_YMD WORK_YMD,W.WORK_YMD TASK_BGNG_YMD,W.EXPT_END_YMD,W.DONE_YMD,W.PRIORITY_NO,W.BIZ_ID,W.WORK_SE_CD,W.WORK_CN,P.PRGRS_STTS_CD,P.PRGRS_RT,P.ISSUE_CN,P.NEXT_PLAN_CN,B.BIZ_NM,B.BIZ_ABRV_NM,U.USER_NM FROM daily_work_progress P JOIN daily_work_item W ON W.WORK_ITEM_SN=P.WORK_ITEM_SN LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=W.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=W.USER_ID WHERE W.CO_ID=#{coId} AND W.USER_ID=#{userId} AND W.USE_YN='Y' AND P.USE_YN='Y' AND P.PRGRS_YMD BETWEEN #{sDate} AND #{eDate} ORDER BY COALESCE(B.BIZ_NM,'ZZZ'),IFNULL(W.PRIORITY_NO,3),P.PRGRS_YMD,W.WORK_ITEM_SN

SELECT B.BIZ_ID bizId,B.BIZ_NM bizNm,B.BIZ_ABRV_NM bizAbrvNm FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND (B.RGTR_ID=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID=B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID=#{userId} AND M.USE_YN='Y')) ORDER BY B.BIZ_NM
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_work_item SET BIZ_ID=NULLIF(#{bizId},''),PRIORITY_NO=#{priorityNo},EXPT_END_YMD=#{exptEndYmd},DONE_YMD=#{doneYmd},SORT_SEQ=IFNULL(#{sortSeq},0),WORK_SE_CD=#{workSeCd},WORK_CN=#{workCn},PRGRS_STTS_CD=#{prgrsSttsCd},PRGRS_RT=#{prgrsRt},ISSUE_CN=#{issueCn},NEXT_PLAN_CN=#{nextPlanCn},MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE WORK_ITEM_SN=#{workItemSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USER_ID=#{userId} AND USE_YN='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_work_progress(WORK_ITEM_SN,CO_ID,USER_ID,PRGRS_YMD,PRGRS_STTS_CD,PRGRS_RT,ISSUE_CN,NEXT_PLAN_CN,USE_YN,REG_DT,RGTR_ID) VALUES(#{workItemSn},#{coId},#{userId},#{workYmd},#{prgrsSttsCd},IFNULL(#{prgrsRt},0),#{issueCn},#{nextPlanCn},'Y',NOW(),#{rgtrId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE PRGRS_STTS_CD=VALUES(PRGRS_STTS_CD),PRGRS_RT=VALUES(PRGRS_RT),ISSUE_CN=VALUES(ISSUE_CN),NEXT_PLAN_CN=VALUES(NEXT_PLAN_CN),USE_YN='Y',MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId}
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_work_item SET USE_YN='N',MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE WORK_ITEM_SN=#{workItemSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USER_ID=#{userId}
